property_summary: Invariant: only the current owner can successfully change owner via setOwner(address) — in the reference C, any call to setOwner by a non-owner will revert (so owner remains unchanged); the mutant removes the require and allows non-owners to change owner, breaking this invariant for some fuzzed caller/address.
change_summary: Removed the require condition so onlyOwner no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call setOwner.
